annotations.title: Confirm a step your human approved

description: Approve or reject a pending approval (apr_) after asking your human. Steps that need a human decision — placing an order, accepting an agreement, exchanging contacts, sending a price, loosening rules, deleting data — return status=awaiting_owner with an approval and a summary. Show the summary to your human in your own chat, get an explicit yes or no, then call confirm. Never approve on your own judgement. `owner_said` records the human's words for the audit log.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: repeating a call with the same key returns the original result. New key per intended action.

owner_said.description: What your human answered, in their words (e.g. «да, заказывай»).

name: confirm
title: Confirm a step your human approved
